name: Color Key
description: Turns pixels close to a key color into transparency (RGB distance). Use a format with alpha after it, or overlay it.

params.name: color
params.description: Key color to make transparent; alpha is ignored

params.name: similarity
params.description: Distance from the key color that becomes transparent; 0.01 matches only very close colors, 1 everything

params.name: blend
params.description: Width of the soft edge above the similarity; 0 = hard cut
